Clicking 'revenue' highlights only its real upstream columns — not every column in every upstream table.

eyebrow: The same graph, as plain SQL
code:
SELECT source_table_full_name, source_column_name,
       target_table_full_name, target_column_name
FROM system.access.column_lineage
WHERE source_column_name = 'ssn'
  AND source_table_full_name = 'hr_catalog.silver.employees';
caption: A repeatable, scheduled compliance query — not a one-time click-through.
